name: restaurant-qr-ordering
description: QR restaurant ordering system — one repo, one command to run client + server together.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
